Lately, I've been thinking about teaching everything to the younger ones and
retiring from the front lines.
Yes, really.

But after losing to you, my thoughts changed.
I want to race in front of you once more.
If I keep racing even when I'm an old lady... you'll be partly responsible... hehe.

...
Did you beat 【MIDNIGHT ROSE】?

...
I admired her.
Someday... I want to beat you and report it to her.

Hmm, seems like you're hitting the roads pretty regularly too, huh?
I see, I see... How about we swap some intel?
So, what news has caught your eye lately?
What?! What about Lehman?!

...Oh, you mean Major League baseball.
Ah, gotcha, gotcha... Being in securities, the word "Lehman" gives me heart palpitations...Hhaha.
Well, catch you later.

【ROLLING GUY NO. 3】 had a big heartbreak, and I wanted to comfort him.
But it might have been counterproductive for me, a newlywed, to speak to him.
...Oh, do you want to hear about my wife?

Recently, 【ROLLING GUY NO. 2】 has been acting superior because he got married.
That guy didn't have a girlfriend, or even proper female friends, for 30 years.
I'm fine... I'd rather focus on establishing driving theories than on love right now.

Oh, you saw me on TV? Thank you.
Many street racers come to the Shuto Expressway without watching TV,
so I'm glad you spoke to me here.

The team has a long history, but I only joined two years ago.
I'm still just "No. 5" for now...
I'm thinking of suggesting something like a "rank swap battle" to energize the team.

I can't race too late.
Working in the market means I have to get up ridiculously early...

I do deliveries, but it's really annoying when people aren't home at the specified time.
I know there are various circumstances, but if it happens too often...

Both 【GOLDEN STEER】 and I inherited parts of our nicknames from our retired mentors.
We need to race in a way that honors those names.

When I was young, I thought I could do everything by myself,
but I've come to realize that I'm here because of the support of many people.
...Though, I'm still a rookie in the street racing world!

That 【WILD BIRD】 has grown from a brat into a grown man.
But he still sometimes refers to himself with the royal "we."
We need to get him to stop that.

I never thought my dad would acknowledge me.
It's time for me to graduate from being a part-timer.
...Next, I need to do something about my brother who left the team.

I just bought some parts from a guy named 【SPIKE MOON】.
They supposedly promise a great performance boost.
I'll install them on my machine right away!

Just because I spend money on sound equipment for my machine doesn't mean I'm neglecting
my driving.
Everyone has their non-negotiable preferences, right?

What's up with you... are you interested in my sideburns?
I spend 30 minutes setting them every day.
Cool, right?

I can see through 【PRIDE KILLER】's schemes.
If he makes a move... that'll be his end.

Looks like 【MAD STRANGER】 is getting cocky again.
...Is it time to pull him from his leadership position?

Oh my, you have a cute face.
Wanna enjoy some XXX kind of XXX with me?
...Come on, I won't bite.

Yo.
Got some good parts, interested?
...Don't ask where they came from, that's boring.

Do you know 【SALTY DOG】?
I promised to have a posing contest with him...

The leader asked me to keep an eye on 【PRIDE KILLER】 to see if he makes any suspicious moves...
That guy's so sloppy.
Does he really think he won't get caught like that...?

My Supra is a special machine.
After my previous partner – my machine – was wrecked in a battle and I was left an empty shell,
my comrades gave me a new partner... filled with their warm thoughts.

...Me?
Oh, I was just taking a break.
Today... is a perfect day for a battle...

What's trending among young folks like you?
I just can't seem to find a conversation starter with my son...

I've moved my artistic expression from "Ukiyo-e" to CG...
I never expected young people to revive "Ukiyo-e" so much.
I also wanted to collaborate with famous foreign films using "Ukiyo-e"...

Hmm, I've lost track of the teacher's sons.
If they aim to become politicians in the future, they need to learn to act with discipline...

I'm over 50 now, but I recently started strength training.
People around me say it's foolish for an old man, but... it feels great, and my back pain is gone.
Why don't you try working out too?

Hey, are you stepping on the ACCELERATOR?
It's a place where you can legally speed.
You gotta go full throttle or it's a waste!

I hate to say it, but
I recommend not getting too involved with our team, 《DEPARTURES》.

Our leader 【HAPPY CHAPPY】 is the biggest problem child of all...
The few good kids are thinking of transferring to another team, and it's giving me a headache...

Hey, hey, what kind of music do you usually listen to?
...Oh, sorry for asking so suddenly!

There are infinite types of music, right?
I want to find great songs I can't discover on my own,
so I ask everyone I meet for recommendations.
If you find any good songs, let me know next time we meet!

There are still many music genres out there.
I thought about adding new members who like different genres to expand the team,
but it would just intensify the "which music is best" debate within the team...

I'm really into classical music.
That's why I admire 《ROAD CONCERTO》, but
I'm terrible at playing, so I can't even talk to them...

Maybe I invited too many industry friends to street racing...
No matter which parking area I go to, 
I meet someone I know and end up talking about work, which is a hassle.

Don't you ever hum game music and let it influence your playing?
Adding jump sounds and shot sounds like percussion,
and then transitioning from the hit sound to the game over BGM...

I managed to get three Yakuman (maximum point) wins in today's game...!
Can I continue this streak in battles?
Or should I think I've used up all my luck today...?

No matter how powerful your machine is,
if you can't transfer traction to the road properly, it's just wasted potential.

Of course, the suspension setup is important...
But I focus on understanding the road conditions, especially the bumps,
and controlling the ACCELERATOR accurately.

The beat of racing is similar to the beat of rock.
I play my groovy rock tunes while keeping the rhythm of my driving.
So, what kind of sound do you drive with?

Yo! Are you racing alone?
I really like this team.
It feels like a "home," and it calms me.

Where should I drive this weekend?
Do you know any good spots?
Somewhere my little sister would enjoy would be great.

I look the same, but I'm the "No. 2" one.
...Well, for now, anyway...
Haha, just kidding!

I joined as a new graduate this year, but being a working adult is tough...
It's a bit different from what I imagined...

Hi! You drive around here too?
Hmm... I'd like to race together sometime.
If you underestimate my machine just because it's light, you'll be in for a surprise.

Have you raced with our leaders yet? They're pretty fast!
By the way, just between you and me, it seems 【UPBEAT GROOVY】
recently met a guy she's interested in.

Hmm... why am I always the one paying for everyone's meals...
Well, I don't mind covering 【LITTLE BEAST】's share...
But this isn't how it's supposed to be...

Reducing weight makes a machine faster.
Before powering up, I focus on weight reduction.

Debuting as a street racer on the Shuto Expressway was my dream.
Achieving it with my club mates, I'm a lucky guy.

They nicknamed me 【UNWELCOME OLD BOY】,
but they really still rely on me.
Well, they're adorable.

I want to focus on driving.
Katsura... oh, I mean 【GREETING MECHANIC】, will work hard enough.

【EROTICA OF LOVE AND ILLUSION】 isn't here, right...?
He was my senpai in school, but if he finds me, it'll be a hassle.
So I'm trying to avoid him as much as possible.

I've been given an outrageous nickname.
Apparently, there was a novel or movie with such a character.
I'm not good with reading, so maybe I'll watch the movie...

I'm a foreign exchange student, but I'm a full-fledged "errand runner."
Yes, an "errand runner"... huh? No? "Errand runner" means a low-ranking person?
Damn it... that stupid senpai tricked me again...!

Is Mitsuru really not planning to go to college?
I know that education isn't everything, but...
I can't stand that jerk older brother looking down on Mitsuru...

"Hellooo? It's meee.
How's the game development going?
I'll check it next week, so make sure there are no simple buuuugs."

Just buying water and going back... just buying water and going back...
No one is watching me... not watching...

Are you married? Having a lifelong partner is a good thing.
There's a saying "marriage is the graveyard of life,"
but I think it's all about communication between the couple.

《ROLLING GUY》, 《ROLLING GALS》, and 《ROULETTE GUY》...
Having three teams of 86 drivers is like a dream for me.
Their rivalry keeps the 86 spirit alive and well.

Oh man, I was really beaten...
The other day, I fell asleep on the train on my way home from work.

When I realized it, the train had reached the terminal of the direction I boarded, then turned 
around and reached the terminal in the opposite direction... I was finally woken up there.
When I was woken up, I was spread-eagled on the floor, and my clothes were covered in dust.

And when I realized it, my bag, wallet, tie... everything was gone.
There were important documents in my bag too.
Well, as you can imagine, I did some soul-searching at that time, yes.

Are you using VINYL and STICKERS?
You should decorate your machine so it stands out from the rest!

Damn, the Daikoku JCT corner was bad... not beautiful!
Winning or losing the battle doesn't matter!
I want to trace the ideal line beautifully as I envision it!

Ah... hello... oh, ciao.
What? Do... Dolce Vita?
Um, I can only speak Japanese! Sorry about that!

I want to keep witnessing the "legends" woven on the Shuto Expressway with my own eyes.
As just another street racer... I want to see it all from this perspective.

But you know... to become "legendary," half-hearted guys won't cut it.
I've decided to weed out those half-baked street racers myself.
Only those who surpass me have the "right" to weave legends.

...Damn it, why is everything my fault!
Sure, I might have a bad mouth, but...
The one who took a bite of my pudding, 【CRIMSON BOY】, is at fault, right?

And that idiot older brother said... "Don't get mad over one bite."
Don't treat me like a kid forever, seriously...
Huh? Do you need something from me?

Times change.
Even the person who stands at the top of the Shuto Expressway has been replaced
over time.

And now a new force is rising.
I want to see through this era.

I always pay attention to my appearance when working...
Even though I'm a voice actor and my face isn't shown!

The teamwork should be good... but
I feel like the other four keep gathering without me for some reason...

I'm a newcomer to the Shuto Expressway too, just like you.
But if anyone looks down on you or gives you trouble, let me know.

I'll crush those guys for you.
Don't hold back, seriously.
We're friends, right?

Are you serious about tuning?
Tuning is crucial for making your machine faster.
I'm always gathering info from magazines and the net, too.

【TIMID CHALLENGER】 is one of those team members you just can't leave alone. 
If you're not by his side, it's too dangerous to watch.

Heh, Shuto Expressway really is on another level. 
If I keep losing, 
the team will tease me again.

I realized...
【DANCING HEROINE】 is a waitress at the maid cafe I go to. Her appearance and behavior are
completely different here and at the cafe, so I never noticed before...

I set up an "escape game" with locks and puzzles in 【BLACK THE ZERO FIGHTER】's room,
but he's so engrossed in shooting games that he doesn't even try to come out.
I guess you have to pick the right people to surprise.

Jun--【HERETIC CANOPUS】 started cross-dressing because of me, didn't he?
I once thought, "Why don't you stop dressing so confusingly?"
But then I thought, "What's wrong with wearing what you like?"... Jun is right.

Where are 【DARK NIGHT'S BETELGEUSE】 and 【HERETIC CANOPUS】?
I've gotten used to acting alone, but we should still be a trio in the parking area.

I once fell to rock bottom, like all the way to hell.
Just being able to race on the Shuto Expressway again makes me happy.

The other day, I accidentally said, "Welcome!" at the drive-thru.
I've been working in customer service too much.
The person there was surprised.

I'm newly married, but I'm a bit insecure and anxious.
【SWEET BLUES】 is very beautiful, so I'm worried other men might hit on her,
or that she might get tired of my overly cautious nature...

I want to spend all my private time working on my car.
I think working overtime or on weekends is a loss.

I can't believe my song is selling...
When dreams come true, it makes me anxious.
To blow away that anxiety, I just keep racing.

Unlike back home, Tokyo's course has tight curves.
Kind of like the personalities of Tokyo people.

Brother, I finally made it here!
There are plenty of strong guys here, right?
I'll beat them all, so watch me, brother!

I'll never forget the humiliation of the expedition 4 years ago.
At that time... only 【DEJIMA TRIAL】 managed to get a girlfriend in Tokyo... Damn.
This time, I'll challenge my limits to get a girlfriend too!

I remember a lot from the last expedition... yeah, I remember it pretty well.
When I came 4 years ago, I was too busy memorizing the course.
But now, I can definitely battle properly.

Since I came to Tokyo,
I want to visit Sarushima at least once during the expedition.

Oh, it's been a while since I came to Tokyo.
I want to get close to a cool girl.
(I should definitely ask where she's from first, yeah)

Tokyo people are all so fair-skinned.
I'm not that tanned even back home,
but here I stand out.

When it comes to battles, I get too heated.
Just like hot springs have the right temperature, you need the right level of heat for battles too.

It's almost been 10 years since I started driving.
【WHITE CAT】 has become reliable lately, but... I can't leave her alone.
Should I start looking for a team that can take care of her for the future...?

Whoa! We got a weird job offer for the team. Apparently, it's about chasing cars 
in a post-apocalyptic dystopia, fighting over water and gasoline. 
They say the outfit is just a helmet and protector over bare skin... Isn't that too shady?

When we encounter them in the parking area... The 《MACHINE RANGERS》 treat us 
like enemies and hassle us... Can't something be done about that? And just because 
our team dresses alike... they call us "soldiers"... At least... make us monsters instead...

I'm an undeniable star on the field, but here, no one talks to me...
Well, if there's a guy wearing this kind of protector in the parking area, they'd be too scared to
approach...

I thought I'd have some fun with the 《MACHINE RANGERS》 guys,
but that 【SENTAI SILVER】 guy said, "I'm the extra warrior" and just watched from above.
If I mess with the others, they'll get hurt...

I want to eat at 【SAGAMI'S SUMO WRESTLER】's chanko restaurant again.
If I go with the team, we'll eat everything in the place, so maybe I'll go secretly...

I feel like there are more and more big-built street racers lately...
Some of them might have the qualities of an athlete.
Should I suggest holding tryouts to the leader?

It seems like many members are just waiting for my instructions.
I need to teach them that as street racers, 
making their own decisions based on the situation is crucial.

It seems 【DEFENSIVE BACK】 is still unsure...
We just need to follow 【SUPREME LINEBACKER】's lead.
It's not like we're capable of thinking for ourselves anyway!

I never thought I'd become a "mom friend" with 【BIG MUM】, but
come to think of it, there are quite a few street racers with kids...
Do you think we could have a mom friends' gathering across team boundaries?

I can sense it from the team's atmosphere.
They're worried I'll have another heartbreak.
This time I'll be fine... How many times have I said that now?

Where did everyone go?
I thought we agreed to meet at this parking area.
For everyone except me to get lost, that's quite a probability...

I admired 【MIDNIGHT ROSE】 and entered this world.
If only I could become a wonderful woman like her...
And I heard she's looking for a disciple... Do you think I have a chance?

I drive an ambulance for work.
I always hope I won't have to pick up street racers.

I admire our leader, 【CRIMSON MIRAGE】.
He's a man who can make the necessary decisions when needed without wavering, even if it involves
pain. That's why I don't regret dropping out of college to prioritize racing.

I've been watching you. You really look like you're having fun racing.
No, sorry, I'm not making fun of you.
I'm genuinely envious.

Don't get intimidated if some weirdo messes with you.
Stay calm, observe, and handle it appropriately. That's the basics!

Our team isn't all about winning.
The question is, "Did I run the race in a way that I am satisfied with?"
We will find the "road" to that result. Don't you think it would be nice to have such a team?

Hmm... this is troublesome.
I need to summarize my driving style for the team meeting...
But how was I driving again?

【LOVE'S ACE SHOOTER】 from 《INFINITY》 keeps inviting me.
He says, "We'll be unbeatable together!"
But that definitely isn't about racing...

I'm a veterinarian, but there aren't many street racers who have pets.
... Well, that makes sense.
For everyone, their machine comes first.

I never thought I'd seriously worry about training the next generation.
It's surprisingly rewarding.

I'm still not enough to stand next to 【BLUE SPEED】.
Experience, caution, courage, everything.

Sometimes people ask me to sing a song, but I have to decline here.
There are fans who pay to see me.
Besides, I'm 【RED SHOUT】 now!

The best music and the fast-flowing nightscape!
This combination will be loved forever.

I love wild birds and I'm doing research on them in grad school.
I don't keep them as pets, though. I think they are amazing when they fly freely.

We've got a new guy, 【BIRD EYE】, who loves wild birds, and even the rough 
【DEMON'S LAIR ON THE ROAD】 has started growing plants...
Here it comes! The wave of nature lovers in the team...!

Ah, it won't rain on the Shuto Expressway for a while.
Trust me, I'm a weather forecaster, so you can count on it.

When I get demanding customers in my tour conductor job, it's really stressful.
I thought 【SEDUCTIVE AQUAMARINE】, the bus guide, would understand, so I talked to her about it.

And then... she had developed the skills to satisfy even those demanding customers and prevent
them from complaining.
I realized the difference in our professional levels…

Everyone in our team is pretty free-spirited.
They tend to do their own thing.
Well, it's fun that way, so it's fine, isn't it?

I wonder where "Big Sis" is racing now.
I have to leave soon, the kids have an early start tomorrow."

I got an invitation to karaoke from 【ROLLING GAL NO. 5】, but what should I do...
I've been hanging out with her every day, and it's not good to neglect my boyfriend...

Why don't my poems or jokes get accepted by my teammates...
Maybe because I'm not a natural weirdo, so it feels artificial...?

Ah, I ran a lot today-.
Let's call it a day and invite 【ROLLING GAL NO. 3】 to karaoke!
It's going to be an all-nighter!

My husband was made to graduate from 《Aquarium》 because he married me.
It's a singles team... and of course, since we're a women's team, 
he can't come over and join us either.

He's currently searching for a new team.
--Should we dress him up like 【HERETIC CANOPUS】 and put him in 《Juicy Heaven》?
...Impossible, there's no way my husband could look that pretty.

Can you see, Yoichi in heaven?
My RX-8 is still as beautiful as ever, right?
I keep it clean every day, just like when you gave it to me...

People say my speaking is... SLOW...
But... foreigners say... it's easier to understand...
And I can... speak in different languages... too...

Hm? Are you a street racer?
Hmm... you don't look the part.
If you become famous, I'll take you on.

It seems like the team is falling apart...
Well, I wasn't really dependent on the team, so it's fine.

"Ms. 【GENTLE ARM SAKAE】, would you like to try my WRX STI?"
...Maybe that's too pretentious? Let's be more casual.

"My WRX STI makes a bit of a rattle at low RPMs,
Ms. 【GENTLE ARM SAKAE】, could you take a look?"
...No, that makes the machine sound bad.

"Ms. 【GENTLE ARM SAKAE】" ....
...Huh? How long have you been there?
You didn't hear anything, right? Nothing, right? Right?!

I've driven cars with all kinds of drivetrains: 4WD, FF, FR, MR, RR.
My shop serves various flavors of ramen: soy sauce, salt, miso, tonkotsu, you name it.
But there are no limits to the flavors of ramen...

Old machines shouldn't be underestimated.
There are lots of ways they can be more fun.

I really want to add a front spoiler to increase grip.
But my family strongly opposes changing the look.
Is it okay to say I bumped it and had to repair it to change it?

Seriously... I shouldn't have treated him to Mapo Eggplant.
Well, it's nice to be called casually by everyone, though.

Because of my small talk, my senpai got a nickname...
I feel a bit sorry about it.
But the taste of the Mapo Eggplant during my first win was special!

The way you drive here is different from the mountain passes.
I used to tackle the mountain passes,
but now I'm adjusting to the driving style here.

My car is old, isn't it? This was the car my mom drove when I was a kid.
She used to take me to and from kindergarten in it every day.
Cars hold a lot of memories, don't they?

Thanks for calling out to me.
Look at my new car... the latest MAZDA3.
Come on, take a look.

How about the beauty of this form!
It retains a retro feel while having a sporty look... not bad, right?
Check out the interior too, feel free to open anything.

And if you finance it now, the monthly payments... oh, ahem.
We formed a team of members who love MAZDA cars.
Wahaha, nice to meet you.

Oh, you came at just the right time.
I need a favor.
I want to check the muffler, can you rev the engine?

...
OK! All clear! No problem!

Thanks for your help!
The muffler was fine.
Oh, this machine's rotary engine has a good sound, right?

What do you imagine when you're driving your beloved car at full speed?
You're not just pressing the accelerator, right?
Yes, imagine.

Imagine... the beauty of air flowing along this streamlined body.
Imagine... the intensity of the tires gripping the road.
Imagine... the strength of the suspension supporting the body while creaking.

Imagine... a hamburger steak loaded with cheese...
Ah, I guess I'm a bit hungry.

Mr. 【IMAJIN】 is my senpai,
and his designs pursuing a beauty that feels alive are truly wonderful.

Well, his guidance is sometimes strict,
and when he starts saying "Imagine...," it can be a bit annoying.

Hey, I've seen you a few times.
Are you also a "street racer"?
Well, you didn't really give off that vibe, so I thought I'd check.

Oh? You think I don't look like a "street racer" either? That might be true.
Recently, I just started a new team with fellow MAZDA car lovers.
I'm a newbie as a street racer and usually just a regular office worker.

Oh, by the way, if you're thinking of switching cars, let me know.
I can introduce you to some good ones.
Well, see you.

I collect mini cars of the machines I've battled.
Heh, it's like my mini car collection is my victory mark.

You! What do you think is the number one anime this season?
There are too many anime in Japan, I can't keep up!

Hmm hmm hmm !
It seems many street racers like music.
I'd love to talk with you.

It's a perfect day for curry today!
I'll give you a discount coupon.
Come to my shop!

Even if I don't have time, I make sure to take breaks at the parking area.
Unlike flights, there's no one to take over for me in my car.

The Shuto Expressway is always lively.
I sometimes come here to relax,
and every time I see new young faces, it makes me happy.

Hey, I've seen you around here recently.
Hm? You see me too?
I guess I've become somewhat famous in this area.

What? You've seen me arguing with a woman?
Wh... what situation... did you see...? You...?
Well, well, well, come here... aren't you hungry? I'll treat you to anything, ha ha ha...

I've been thinking my diet is unbalanced lately, so I've been taking a lot of vitamins.
But I still felt unwell, so I went to the hospital and was told "Your liver is bad."

Yo, my machine is pretty flashy, right?
If you want to add some lights like that, consult me.
Ah... ahh... are you planning to buy a new washing machine?

Hey, are you working out?
If you feel out of shape, why not join the sports event I'm hosting?
A well-trained body can make a difference in reaction time when driving.

Are you a grip or drift type?
I enjoy both.
That's why I bought a 2000 cc FR car that can do both.

Good evening.
It's nice to drive a machine.
When you're focused on driving and looking ahead, you can forget about everything else.

In a battle, you shouldn't give up just because you're lagging behind.
At speeds of around 200 km/h, if the opponent makes one mistake, you can catch up instantly.
Like the firmness of udon, persistently pursue.

Oh, good evening.
I'm glad you came to see me, but...
tonight, I feel like being alone.
Fufufu... I'm such a fickle woman, aren't I?

A new movement is starting on the Shuto Expressway.
This will be a turning point for many street racers and a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
Heh heh, keep your eyes peeled.

*Sigh*... My younger brothers fight so often that it gives me a headache.
I wish they understood how hard it is to mediate every time.

We have a rule that we settle fights with a machine battle,
but the process to get there is long and exhausting.
*Sigh*...

He-he-hee.
You came up to talk to me...
Could it be... you want to borrow my "wisdom"?

...W-what? Huh?
S-stop staring at me like that!
Are you making fun of me!?

Ooh! There's not enough soda!
What do you mean it's sold out!?

I never thought that the drawings I made for fun would be useful to others.
Even brother 【SHUWA SHUWA STRONG】 has put the EMBLEM I drew on his car.

Hm? You want to know about 《ROLLING GUY》?
They're one of the oldest teams on the Shuto Expressway.
They have a strong passion for AE86 machines.

The current leader is of the second generation of leaders, I believe.
The first leader is now racing solo.

Many teams have been formed under their influence.
Now there are teams like 《ROLLING GALS》 and 《ROULETTE GUY》.

The team names are similar, and they call their members "number something,"
so it's getting hard for this old man to tell them apart.

《Fresh Market》 you say?
I'm glad you asked me!

That team consists of people who work in the fresh seafood business.
One member, 【SAGAMI'S SUMO WRESTLER】, runs a chanko restaurant,
and it's quite successful.

I'm a regular at his place!
Ah, I'm getting hungry...
I think I'll go eat there again...

Haaa.
The guys from 《PHASE X》 casually hitting on me, it's annoying.

They're young and annoyingly energetic,
but they don't have much money,
so their machines aren't well-tuned either.

They might be passionate,
but I'm not interested in empty-pocketed guys.

《RED POLLUTION》?
Oh, just avoid them when you see them.
You don't even need to make eye contact.

MR is a layout where the engine is placed in front of the rear axle, driving the rear wheels.
With the center of gravity in the middle of the car, 
it excels in handling and turning performance.

However, there are drawbacks, such as the engine being in the center of the car,
which can make the interior cramped and limit cargo space.

For someone like me who does maintenance, it's often a challenge, 
but it makes my skills shine.

Do you know about RR?
Most manufacturers have stopped using the RR layout, so you don't see it often.

The engine is in the rear, similar to MR,
but the key difference is that the engine is placed behind the rear axle.

Nowadays, most manufacturers don't make RR layout cars,
but some still stick to it.

Someone doesn't know what F4 is?!
F4 is a flat-four engine with four cylinders.

The cylinders are arranged horizontally opposite each other,
so it looks like a boxer throwing punches, hence it's also called a boxer engine.
It's crazy that there are people driving without knowing this.

Do you know what it means when it says L4 or L6 on the engine type?
It means the engine is an inline engine.

The inline engine is the most standard type, and the number indicates the cylinders.
L4 means it's an inline engine with four cylinders.

By the way, an engine where pistons move up and down within the cylinders 
is called a reciprocating engine.
The up-and-down motion is the source of power.

When it says V6 or V8 on the engine type, 
it means it's a V-type engine.

To increase power by adding more cylinders, inline engines become long and bulky, 
so they're arranged in a V shape to make them compact.

The position of each head being lower allows for a lower center of gravity, 
which leads to better stability.

NA refers to an engine that uses natural aspiration without a supercharger, 
using negative pressure in the cylinders.
